outcome: The cloaked card enters the battlefield face down as a 2/2 creature with ward {2} and no name or mana cost.
A cloaked permanent may be turned face up for its mana cost only if its card is a creature card with a mana cost; turning it face up restores its characteristics.
note: Which face-up procedures are legal is an engine verdict; the choice between them is the player's.

outcome: A cloaked card with morph may be turned face up for its morph cost as well as for its mana cost.
note: Which face-up procedures are legal is an engine verdict; the choice between them is the player's.

outcome: A cloaked card with disguise may be turned face up for its disguise cost as well as for its mana cost.
note: Which face-up procedures are legal is an engine verdict; the choice between them is the player's.

outcome: Several cards cloaked from a library enter the battlefield face down one at a time.
If the face-down object is prohibited from entering the battlefield, the card stays in its previous zone with unmodified characteristics.
A cloaked instant or sorcery that would turn face up stays face down and turned-face-up triggers do not fire.
